Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the version.
Theme* (xref:#entidad-theme[Theme])::
Theme this version belongs to.
Channel* (ThemeVersionChannelOptions)::
Channel the layout is for: MAIL or HTML page.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * MAIL
 * HTML

Locale (string)::
BCP 47 locale of the layout (es, en, fr...). Empty for the default version.
Content html* (blob)::
Handlebars layout; the template is placed in {{{slot_content}}}, and {{title}}, {{locale}}, {{theme_assets_path}} and {{tenant_name}} are available.
Content text (blob)::
Plain-text layout for email clients that do not show HTML.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de theme version para controlar bloqueos optimistas
